roleContext.roleTitle: Product Delivery Manager, Merchant Onboarding Portal
roleContext.jobDescription: The merchant onboarding portal takes small businesses from application to an active payment account. The Product Delivery Manager runs releases into the merchant-facing portal: has taken releases through to live use by merchants, owns the release calendar and the go-live checklist, runs post-release monitoring with operations and handles release incidents affecting merchants, and documents the boundaries of each release. Acceptance testing experience alone does not meet the bar for this role. The role reports to the head of merchant products and works with engineering, the change management office, operations and the merchant support desk on every release.

requirements.text: Has taken portal releases through to live use by merchants and run the go-live weekends.
Owns the release calendar for the merchant-facing portal and the go-live checklist.
Runs post-release monitoring with operations and handles release incidents affecting merchants.
Manages user acceptance testing across release candidates, including the acceptance calendar, sign-off tracking and defect triage with engineering.
Documents residual defects and hand-over conditions for each release candidate.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Product Delivery Manager, Merchant Onboarding Portal

## Experience

- Managed the user acceptance testing programme for the merchant onboarding portal rebuild in the UAT environment across three release candidates, running the acceptance calendar and the acceptance sign-off tracker for the business testers.
- Coordinated defect triage between the business testers and engineering for each release candidate, keeping the triage log and the retest schedule in the UAT environment.
- The go-live itself, the release calendar for the merchant-facing portal and the post-release monitoring were run by the bank's change management office and the operations team; my role ended at acceptance hand-over.
- Wrote the acceptance report and the hand-over pack for each release candidate, listing residual defects, the test data limitations of the UAT environment and the conditions handed to the change office.
- Two years on the portal rebuild programme covered acceptance testing management, the acceptance calendar, defect triage, acceptance reports and hand-over packs.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the acceptance sign-off tracker and the hand-over pack for release candidate three, with the UAT environment's build numbers as a verification trail.
